$comment: How the gateway names the principals it acts for, under the knowledge base's domain (its committed `[site] domain`). A person is `did:web:{domain}:users:{subject}`, where the subject is the value of the claim `identity.subjectClaim` names. A software agent is `did:web:{domain}:agents:{provider}:{model}`, with the address `{slug}@agents.{host}` and the name `{provider} {model}`: {host} is the domain up to its first colon, and {slug} is `{provider}:{model}` with every run of characters outside [A-Za-z0-9-] replaced by one hyphen and a hyphen at either end removed. Every part of a DID after the domain is percent-encoded as ECMAScript's encodeURIComponent does: each UTF-8 byte of a character other than A–Z a–z 0–9 - _ . ! ~ * ' ( ) becomes %XX in uppercase hex; the domain is written as it is. Held by: @semiont/core's userToDid, agentToDid and didToAgent (principals-agreement.test.ts), the gateway conformance suite (every case, against a running gateway), and the Rust gateway's runner.

people.why: a subject of letters and digits is itself
people.subject: alice

people.why: a colon in the subject is encoded, so it cannot split the DID
people.subject: google-oauth2:104859221

people.why: a slash in the subject is encoded
people.subject: tenant/alice

people.why: a character outside ASCII is its UTF-8 bytes, each percent-encoded
people.subject: josé

people.why: the characters encodeURIComponent leaves alone stay as they are
people.subject: a-b_c.d!e~f*g'h(i)j

agents.why: a provider and model of letters, digits and hyphens are themselves
agents.name: anthropic claude-sonnet-5

agents.why: a colon in the model is encoded in the DID and becomes a hyphen in the address
agents.name: ollama gemma2:27b

agents.why: a slash in the model is encoded in the DID
agents.name: ollama library/llama3

agents.why: dots in the model are kept in the DID and become hyphens in the address
agents.name: anthropic claude-3.5-sonnet

agents.why: a run of characters outside [A-Za-z0-9-] is one hyphen in the address, none at either end
agents.name: my provider (beta)::model!
